reconstruction.method: Factory wheelbase and manually inspected wheel-hub pixels fit a perspective camera and a 10-degree turntable. The intersection of all alpha silhouettes produces a volumetric mesh. Adjacent calibrated official photographs are projected onto the exterior at runtime. Unseen roof/hood surfaces, roof rails, hood loops, underbody and the open pickup bed are inferred and explicitly separate.

limits: Dimensions follow the shared vehicle specification. This is calibrated photographic reconstruction with inferred unobserved surfaces, not imported manufacturer geometry, factory CAD or a measured scan. Source exterior trim and wheel style can differ from the simulated powertrain. The independently authored kgm-refined.js body remains the Canvas/asset-loading fallback. No photo/mesh redistribution license is claimed. Public web sources can change. Unsuccessful mesh searches do not establish that no mesh exists elsewhere.
